scenes.visual: Title card: kicker tag 'Sample lesson', big title 'Adding Two Vectors', italic hook 'tip to tail'.

cues.say: Welcome. Today we add two vectors.

scenes.visual: Chapter card: Chapter 1, 'Tip to tail', tagline 'components add separately'.

Grid figure on the left: A = <3,1> in blue from the origin (cue a), B = <1,2> in gold from the tip of A (cue b), sum <4,3> in green from origin (cue c). Derivation on the right: A+B = <3+1, 1+2> = <4,3>, boxed.

cues.say: Put B, one, two, at the tip of A.

scenes.visual: CHECKPOINT header, MCQ 'What is <2,0> + <0,2>?' options A <2,2> (right), B <4,0>, C <0,4>, D <2,0>. Countdown during think; reveal on cue ans.

cues.say: What is two, zero plus zero, two?
The answer is A: two, two.
